label: removals queue
description: One message per customer to remove, published by POST /customers/{id}/removal. missing is acknowledged (the customer is already gone: the work is done); upstream is retried up to five times, a second apart and then doubling, and then dead-lettered. Employees holding the registrar role only, as for DELETE /customers/{id}: the token rides in the message's headers, and a message whose token does not verify is dead, since redelivering it cannot help.
